subject: chemistry
question_text: How is an excessive amount of CO₂ responsible for global warming?

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: How CO₂ absorbs the heat
lines: Sunlight passes through the air and
warms the surface of the earth.
The warm surface then radiates heat back
Carbon dioxide in the air absorbs this
radiated heat, so less of it passes out
into space and more of it stays in the
steps.why: Carbon dioxide is transparent to the incoming sunlight but absorbs the heat radiation the warm surface radiates back. Heat therefore enters the atmosphere more easily than it leaves, and that one-way difference is what raises the temperature.
common_mistakes: Writing that CO₂ stops sunlight from reaching the earth. Sunlight passes through; it is the heat radiated back from the surface that CO₂ absorbs.
Writing that CO₂ produces heat. It does not produce heat; it absorbs the heat radiated by the earth's surface.
steps.memory_tip: Sunlight goes in easily but the radiated heat does not come out easily — carbon dioxide absorbs it on the way out.
steps.margin_note: Say that the heat radiated by the surface is absorbed, not that sunlight is blocked.

steps.label: Why the amount is rising
lines: The amount of CO₂ in the air increases
when fossil fuels are burnt, when
The more CO₂ there is, the more of the
radiated heat is absorbed, so the
rises. This rise is global warming.
steps.why: The word in the question is 'excessive'. A normal amount of CO₂ keeps the earth warm enough to live on; it is the increase above that amount which raises the temperature further, so the answer has to name what causes the increase.
common_mistakes: Naming only the burning of fuels. Decomposition of limestone and a fall in the number of trees also raise the amount of CO₂.
Writing that CO₂ makes a hole in the ozone layer. That is a separate effect; global warming is the absorption of radiated heat.
steps.memory_tip: Two things add CO₂ — burning fuels and limestone breaking down — and cutting trees takes away what removes it.
steps.margin_note: Naming the sources of the extra CO₂ is what answers the word excessive in the question.

insider_note: A complete answer has two halves: how carbon dioxide absorbs the heat radiated by the earth's surface, and what is putting more of it into the air. Many students write only the second half.
